digest: Verified: the WHATWG DOM Standard explicitly assigns AbortSignal.timeout() a TimeoutError DOMException reason.
verdictDigest: The WHATWG DOM Standard directly specifies TimeoutError DOMException as timeout()’s abort reason, both descriptively and in the normative algorithm. Source: https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/

evidence.quote: Returns an AbortSignal instance which will be aborted in milliseconds milliseconds. Its abort reason will be set to a “TimeoutError” DOMException.
evidence.relevance: Direct normative description of AbortSignal.timeout()’s abort reason.

evidence.quote: Queue a global task on the timer task source given global to signal abort given signal and a new “TimeoutError” DOMException.
evidence.relevance: Normative timeout algorithm constructs and applies the TimeoutError DOMException.

caveats: The standard specifies the signal.reason value; whether an observing API rejects a Promise, and how, depends on that API.
